overall_goal: Prepare the puff pastry by adding grated cheeses and folding it in half

goals.description: Retrieve the ingredients and open the puff pastry
goals.rationale: The person gathers the puff pastry, cheddar cheese, and shredded cheese from the fridge and countertop, then opens the puff pastry wrapper.

goals.description: Open the packet of grated cheese and sprinkle it over the puff pastry
goals.rationale: The person cuts open the bag of grated cheese and repeatedly grabs handfuls to scatter evenly across the unrolled puff pastry.

goals.description: Prepare the grater and grate cheddar cheese over the puff pastry
goals.rationale: The person dries the cheese grater, unwraps the block of cheddar cheese, and grates it directly over the puff pastry.

goals.description: Fold the puff pastry in half and seal the edges
goals.rationale: The person adjusts the cheese filling, folds the puff pastry over to close it like a book, and presses down firmly to seal the edges.
